title: ProposalApply
description: RFC 0249 §C. The optional `applyProposal` body binding the apply to the bytes the reviewer read. A host MAY require it (`400 validation_error`, `details.field: artifactDigest`). A digest that differs from the proposal's current `artifactDigest` MUST be refused `409 proposal_stale`, installing nothing.

artifactDigest.description: `sha256:` + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of the reviewed `artifact`.
